requiredState: current setup completion version is durably persisted
language and current area are preserved
the user is not already authoritatively authenticated

states.rule: The provider owns its native or secure browser approval surface. MoolSocial never reproduces provider credentials or consent.

states.validation: Normalize and validate the selected target before requesting a code.

states.mobileAutofill: Use operating-system one-time-code autofill APIs; never read the SMS inbox silently.

states.result: merge setup into the authenticated account and open Universal immediately

providerRules.youtube: Use Google basic identity only. Request YouTube channel scopes later and only from creator tools with feature-specific consent.
providerRules.instagram: Show only when production provider configuration and policy support it; never leave a dead action.
security: no raw provider credentials collected by MoolSocial UI

routing.authenticatedExit: /app/social unless a valid captured /app/ return route exists
routing.interruptionRule: Process death or relaunch during incomplete OTP returns to sign-in without claiming authentication.

reviewConnectionRule.liveProductionBoundary: Production authentication uses environment-supplied live Firebase/provider configuration; local review routing is never a production identity path.

prohibited: mixing legacy SignInScreen or VerifyOtpScreen into UI V2
fake provider success in a production build
internal implementation, example, review or test language in customer copy
dropping Screen 02 area state during authentication
